_comment: Copy to user-config.json. Every field is optional — these are the defaults. Secrets belong in .env, never here. Edits are picked up within 5 minutes without a restart.
_screening: Pools must clear every one of these before the model ever sees them.
_range: Geometry. widthPct is the total span; skew is the share of it below the base price (1 = one-sided, entering in the quote asset).
_exits: Enforced by arithmetic, not by the model.
_schedule: watcherIntervalSec drives trailing take-profit between cron cycles.
_llm: Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint with tool calling. Point llmBaseUrl at the API root (usually ending in /v1) and use whatever model ids that endpoint expects. Switchable at runtime: `aeternum config set llmBaseUrl https://...` takes effect on the next cycle.
_llmApiKey: Prefer LLM_API_KEY in .env. This field works, but user-config.json is the file people paste into issues and screenshots — a key here leaks easily. Local servers usually accept any non-empty string.
_models: Model ids as YOUR endpoint names them; they differ between providers. Screening benefits most from a capable model. Tool calling is mandatory — an endpoint or model without it cannot run this agent, which `scripts/preflight.sh` verifies before a long run.
_maxTokens: Reasoning models spend this same budget on their internal trace before writing anything, so 4096 can leave nothing for the reply. If reports come back empty, raise this first — the agent logs the reasoning-token count when it happens.
_chain: slippageBps applies to deposits, withdrawals and swaps.
_dashboard: Read-only status page: open positions, PnL, exit mix, decisions, lessons. Reads only the local ledgers, so opening it costs no RPC calls. Loopback by default; set dashboardHost to 0.0.0.0 to reach it from the LAN, which requires a token (one is generated and logged if you do not set one).
_hivemind: Blank url = disabled. Nothing leaves the machine until you set one.
